description: Add-on for Umbraco.Community.ContentFreeze: freezes Umbraco Commerce settings in the backoffice while a content freeze is active, and stops product stock from changing when a frozen product save is blocked. Orders, carts, checkout and payments keep working.
Add-on for Umbraco.Community.ContentFreeze: holds back Hangfire jobs (for example from Cultiv.Hangfire) while a content freeze is active and runs them once it ends.

Add-on for Umbraco.Community.ContentFreeze: freezes the Umbraco AI configuration (connections, profiles, contexts, guardrails, settings, prompts and agents) in the backoffice while a content freeze is active. Using AI keeps working.

Add-on for Umbraco.Community.ContentFreeze: freezes Umbraco Forms forms, workflows, folders, data sources and prevalue sources in the backoffice while a content freeze is active. Website form submissions keep working.

Freeze content and media editing in the Umbraco backoffice during deployments, migrations and uSync imports. Schedule a freeze from your CI/CD pipeline, warn editors with a countdown, and let it expire automatically.

Quartz.NET-backed durable deadlines for Sagant. Implements IWorkflowDeadlineScheduler over a Quartz scheduler, so a deployment already running Quartz with a persistent job store keeps a waiting instance's wake in those tables. Depends on the Sagant core alone, so it serves any Sagant runtime.
Builds, applies and reverts KSP Retooled patch files.
The retooled-patch command, which builds, checks, applies and reverts KSP Retooled patch files.
Frames for Moonwell maps: panels, text, images and the rest of a map's own UI, each player's own.
JSON for Moonwell maps: a tree to read and write, with System.Text.Json.Nodes' names.
XrmToolBox Tool. Find any table, column, choice or relationship in your Dataverse metadata, fast.
Loads .NET solutions and projects with MSBuildWorkspace so Ariadne.NET can check architecture rules against the compiler's semantic model.
An encryption and hashing library that simplifies AES, RSA, ML-KEM, and SHA-256 operations.
The .NET client for monic: one log for the database and the bus. Not released yet.

Snapshot tests for PDFs with PdfPecker: compare a generated PDF with a stored one after leaving out dates, file IDs and compression, and get page images with the changed pixels marked when they differ. Also checks for text and page counts. Works with xUnit, NUnit, MSTest or any other test framework…

Razor components (.razor) to PDF with PdfPecker: typed templates with layouts, child components and dependency injection, rendered to HTML with Microsoft's HtmlRenderer and converted to PDF without a browser, an ASP.NET Core host or native binaries.

The pdfpecker command-line tool: HTML and Markdown to PDF (with wkhtmltopdf-compatible options and a watch mode), merge, split, rotate, compact, sign, verify and encrypt PDFs, and PDF to image, HTML and text. Needs no browser and no native binaries.

WithEffect.Core assembles well-known packages for rapid application prototyping in contexts of Cyber Physical System (CPS). WithEffect.Testkit.TestBlazorWebApp is the default Blazor Server for xUnit integration tests, used for WebApplicationFactory.

Cartovia WinUI 3 map control: vector maps with MapLibre GL JS (no account needed) or Mapbox GL JS, hosted in the WinUI WebView2: every layer type and style property, expressions, markers, popups, controls, plugins, events and a bindable two-way camera.
